svg.title: Spain invoice preparation, issuance and sending
svg.desc: Four horizontal responsibility lanes. ERP submits complete draft data for service validation, issues and submits final data. The service resolves the recipient route, uses the public platform when no private entry point exists, and tracks recipient delivery and any required public copy independently. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.
